title: final without execution-only levers
description: The final package with KD2, KD4, KD5, KD6 (with KD7 / KD8), IPC, IPW, BVR and CDIO off. KD3 stays on because REC needs it. KD3 on with KD2 off was never packaged by the chain, so this combination is unverified; a run fails if REC or KD3 is not active on the GPU. Outputs should equal the final package's except for KD5's fp16 rounding-order differences.
